title: Libera Nos a Malo
description: This is a QTE horror game inspired by 1970s horror movies.This game contains scenes of exorcism and demonic possession, Christian religious themes, disturbing imagery, screams, and moments of intense psychological tension. Some content may be unsettling for certain players. Will you be able to save the girl from demonic possession, or will evil prevail?
